Title: Mila's First Garden
StoryText: Mila found a small seed in the yard. She dug a hole and planted the seed carefully. Every morning, Mila watered the seed and waited. After many days, a tiny green sprout appeared. Mila took care of the plant as it grew taller each week. Finally, the plant bloomed into a bright yellow sunflower.
